title: Clients set unexpected fields because ValidationPipe whitelist is off
symptoms: Extra JSON properties persist to DB
role or isAdmin flipped by crafted payloads
DTO TypeScript types look correct but runtime accepts extras
cause: Without whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted, undeclared properties can pass through into services/ORMs.
solution: Enable ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }) globally; decorate DTO fields explicitly.
